def compile_document(document):
    """Validate the whole document and compile every template."""
    exact(document,['seed','definitions','timeout_ms','cases','events','channels'])
    seed = text(document['seed'],64)
    if SEED.fullmatch(seed) is None:
        raise ValueError('seed')
    definitions = sequence(document['definitions'],MAX_DEFINITIONS)
    sources = []
    for row in definitions:
        if type(row) is not list or len(row)!=2:
            raise ValueError('definition pair')
        name = text(row[0],32)
        if DEFINITION_NAME.fullmatch(name) is None or keyword.iskeyword(name):
            raise ValueError('definition name')
        sources.append((name,text(row[1],MAX_EXPRESSION)))
    context = Context(sources,seed)
    timeout = integer(document['timeout_ms'],1,MAX_TIMEOUT)

    cases = sequence(document['cases'],MAX_CASES)
    names = set()
    budget = 0
    pairs = [0]
    validated = []
    for case in cases:
        exact(case,['name','frames','expect'])
        name = text(case['name'],32)
        if NAME.fullmatch(name) is None or name in names:
            raise ValueError('case name')
        names.add(name)
        frames = sequence(case['frames'],MAX_BUDGET)
        budget += len(frames)
        pause_total = 0
        for frame in frames:
            validate_frame(frame,pairs)
            if frame['Type']=='sleep':
                pause_total += frame['Time_to_Stop']
        if pause_total+timeout>MAX:
            raise ValueError('time overflow')
        expect = case['expect']
        exact(expect,['method','target','host'])
        visible(expect['method'])
        visible(expect['target'])
        visible(expect['host'])
        if TOKEN.fullmatch(expect['method'].encode('ascii')) is None:
            raise ValueError('expected method')
        validated.append({'name':name,'frames':frames,'expect':expect})

    payload = compile_cases(validated)

    records = sequence(document['events'],MAX_BUDGET)
    budget += len(records)
    events = []
    for index,record in enumerate(records):
        if type(record) is not dict:
            raise ValueError('event')
        kind = record.get('kind')
        if kind=='close':
            exact(record,['at','kind'])
